Ambition is the root of an amazing achievement by any human being. But sometimes this ambition turns into overambition and that leads to a downfall. Well, this game is an incredible example of things can go wrong. Two amazing players - fantastic moves. Check out the battle between Wesley So and Arjun Erigaisi from Total Chess World Championship 2026 in Budapest.
